content:
CIA report summarizes (UFO) sightings reported in French Morocco (now Morocco) and French West Africa (including areas like Dakar in Senegal and Conakry in Guinea) during July 1952. #ufotwitter

Key Sightings Summarized in the Report

Dakar (French West Africa), July 3, 1952 (around 06:08): An eyewitness (reported in the Dakar weekly France-Afrique) described a flat, tapered "saucer" object emitting bluish and reddish flames. It moved southward at high speed at about 1,500 meters altitude. Stars were still visible earlier, but no longer at the time of sighting; no conventional aircraft were in the area.

Mechra bel Ksiri / Had Kourt (Morocco), July 12, 1952 (night): Two policemen on duty reported seeing two elongated "flying saucers" moving from north to south at high speed, followed by a trail of white light.

Fedala (near Casablanca, Morocco), July 13, 1952 (around 23:45): Inhabitants observed a blue-green, ball-shaped object with a short light trail, moving at high speed. It disappeared quickly (in 3–4 seconds), as if "melting" into the sky.

Irfrane to Meknes direction (Morocco), July 14, 1952 (around 09:00): A man and his wife watched a mysterious flying object for about 30 seconds, traveling in the direction of Meknes.

The document notes these were published in local papers like France-Afrique (Dakar) and others in Casablanca, with no further details on official investigations at the time.
